verdict.rationale: PayPal defines a machine-readable offer schema, but the evidence frames it as merchants publishing feeds to PayPal, not developers reading offer data for any listed product. Store Sync ingests Google or OpenAI ACP product feeds, one row per variant, with required price, availability and link fields, and says AI agents can then discover products. The agent toolkit adds list_product and show_product_details, which read only the merchant's own PayPal catalog. missing for 10: a documented developer- or agent-facing read/query API for offer data across all listed products, explicit variant and checkout-link exposure on the read side, self-serve rather than form-gated access, coverage beyond US physical goods in USD, and independent hands-on corroboration.
